title: Quick Care
description: Developed a multi role healthcare platform (Patient/Doctor/Admin) with Flutter and Firebase for appointment booking.
Integrated Paymob payment gateway, MailerSend SMTP for notifications, and location based doctor discovery.
Integrated AI chatbot using GPT-3.5-turbo API and secure document storage.
shortDescription: Real-time appointment booking system with Firebase, multi-role dashboards (patient/doctor/admin), payments, FCM notifications, secure document storage, and location features.

title: AcademIQ
description: Built a multi modal AI education app with 20+ learning modes and seamless LLM migration (ChatGPT → Gemini).
Designed a multi input pipeline integrating OCR, speech-to-text, PDF extraction, and vision AI.
Developed offline first architecture using Isar DB with Riverpod for persistent sessions.
shortDescription: AI educational chatbot with configurable modes (Essay, Poem, etc.), custom session management, offline chat history via Isar DB, and optimized caching for reduced latency.

title: Side Hustle
description: Developed cross platform rewards app with AppsFlyer SDK for install attribution tracking.
Engineered device fingerprinting with 15+ signals (IDFA, IP, VPN) for fraud prevention.
Designed tiered redemption system for 12+ countries with WebSocket real time updates.
shortDescription: Rewards platform for game installations with real-time attribution (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust), multi-platform auth (Google/Apple), dynamic incentive system, and automated payouts.

title: Diecarz
description: Developed a social collection app for diecast enthusiasts with real time feed, follow/like system, and CSV bulk import.
Built Python ETL scripts processing 57K rows, normalizing data, uploading images to Firebase Storage, batch importing via Parquet.
Implemented advanced filtering across multiple metadata fields with optimized Firestore indexes and Mixpanel analytics.
shortDescription: Social collection platform for diecast enthusiasts with wishlist, CSV import, real-time community feed, Mixpanel analytics, optimized Firestore queries, and 99.9% crash-free performance.

title: Caregiver Management App
description: Added task management with recurring schedules, media attachments, and 9 language localization (including RTL).
Extended push notification system with deep linking and FCM token lifecycle fixes.
Resolved critical bugs in Firebase sync and authentication, improving user retention by 30%.
shortDescription: Healthcare app connecting caregivers and family with real-time multilingual chat, task assignment, auto-translation, pixel-perfect UI, and 30% improvement in user retention.

title: AI Planner
description: Led migration from Claude AI to OpenAI with structured outputs and parallel function calling (17 concurrent executions), reducing latency by 50%+.
Rebuilt cross platform notifications system supporting recurring reminders with complex scheduling patterns.
Fixed critical state handling bugs including data persistence and exception handling.
shortDescription: AI scheduling app extracting tasks and reminders from chat, migrated from Claude to OpenAI APIs with structured outputs and parallel calling, 50% faster response time, and optimized state management.

title: JackJack
description: Developed cross platform BLE companion app for child monitoring with real time audio streaming, threshold based alerts, and notification history.
Architected dual mode system with seamless foreground/background state transfer and robust auto reconnection using flutter_reactive_ble.
Built background service isolate with lifecycle aware state management for 24/7 monitoring.
shortDescription: BLE-based child monitoring app with real-time sound level detection, live streaming from device, automated alerts for crying/noise thresholds, and caregiver notifications.

title: Portfolio & Assets Platform
description: Built a two repo headless CMS with GitHub raw URLs as CDN, manifest driven asset resolution, and parallel data loading, achieving zero hosting costs for 100+ MB of assets.
Developed an interactive Flutter Web SPA with Forge2D physics engine (draggable skill pills, throwable emojis), glassmorphism design system, command palette, and scroll reveal animations.
Automated CV PDF generation from JSON data with sequential CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions and visibility flag filtering for independent CV and portfolio content control.
shortDescription: Interactive Flutter Web portfolio with Forge2D physics, glassmorphism design, command palette, terminal boot loader, headless CMS via GitHub raw URLs, automated CV generation, and easter eggs.

title: Sales Quotation Management System
description: Building a full stack B2B quoting platform (React, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core 8, SQL Server) enabling 20+ concurrent users to generate quotes with automated pricing and PDF output.
Integrating three external systems (Enapps ERP, KREO AI, WooCommerce) with rule based pricing engine processing 20+ underfloor heating configurations.
Implemented JWT authentication, role based access control, and audit logging.
shortDescription: Full stack B2B quoting platform enabling 20+ concurrent users to generate quotes with automated pricing, multi-system integration (ERP, AI, e-commerce), role based access, and PDF output.
